thread:
deploy-bot: Deploy to staging blocked for commit `v2.3.1-rc.7` (sha: `a1b2c3d4`). CI gate failed — checks: integration-tests (search_index_test), e2e-suite (flaky), license-scan. Build: https://ci.internal/redwood/5678. Environment: staging.

micah_eng: saw this, re-running the integration job only.

zoe_pm: thanks — quick question: do we want to abort promotion to canary or try a rerun first?

emma_release: staging only right now, so no rollback needed yet. hold canary until green.

raj_sre: looking at the logs — `search_index_test` times out during index reconcile, step 12/27. stack shows RPC `kv_cache_sync` delay ~7s (timeout is 5s). could be infra or test flake.

micah_eng: re-run queued for just `integration-tests` job by @micah_eng — job id 2345. link: https://ci.internal/redwood/5678/jobs/2345

ci-gate-bot: ci-gate-bot: Re-run started (job 2345) requested by micah_eng.

micah_eng: if it fails again i'll try a localized debug build and reproduce locally, otherwise will cherry-pick a small backoff patch.

deploy-bot: CI gate update: re-run finished — integration-tests still failing: `search_index_test` (same stack). Blocking deploy. Marked blocker ticket DEPLOY-1023.

zoe_pm: ugh. ok — plan options: 1) try infra-retry and rerun 2) pin to last-green `v2.3.0` and promote that to canary 3) emergency hotfix/cherry-pick. preferences?

emma_release: prefer pin to `v2.3.0` for canary to keep rollout schedule, and cut a hotfix branch off rc.7 to debug in parallel.

raj_sre: will check infra metrics for the staging cluster (network/io) — if we see elevated latency we can justify transient infra flake. assigning @raj_sre to follow up.

micah_eng: quick log excerpt: ```
[2026-02-11T15:40:12Z] ERROR search_index_test: timeout waiting for reconcile
[2026-02-11T15:40:12Z] rpc: kv_cache_sync failed after 7000ms
[2026-02-11T15:40:12Z] retry=1
```

zoe_pm: good capture. emma, can you create the pin PR and update release notes so PMs know we're holding canary?

emma_release: done — created PR: https://git.internal/redwood/release/pins/123 (pins canary->`v2.3.0`) and added note in the release tracker DEPLOY-1023.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Promotion to canary prevented; target remains staging commit `v2.3.1-rc.7`.

micah_eng: i'll open a debug run that increases timeouts + enable extra trace. If retry shows infra issue we can revert the change that increased cache pressure.

raj_sre: quick mitigation suggestion: add `retry: 2` to the flakey CI step for now to avoid blocking rollout while we root cause. will discuss with CI owners.

zoe_pm: fine with temporary retry if it buys us time, but only after we confirm it's infra flake. do not silently change gating policy.

micah_eng: agreed. i'll reproduce locally first and post results here.

emma_release: adding note to the release channel and tagging stakeholders.

deploy-bot: Status summary — blocked: true, reason: integration-tests failure (search_index_test), action: hold canary; pin PR created; follow-ups assigned to micah_eng and raj_sre.

micah_eng: follow-up: i couldn't reproduce locally, infra metrics show a spike in IO at 15:38Z on staging nodes. raj, can you correlate?

raj_sre: confirming — staging cluster had a short IO spike 15:37–15:41Z, likely due to backup job collision. filing infra ticket INFRA-789 and will add guard to avoid backups during heavy CI windows.

zoe_pm: thanks. decision: keep canary pinned to `v2.3.0` for now, proceed with hotfix branch for rc.7. micah, emma — coordinate on rollback PR and hotfix.

micah_eng: working on hotfix branch now. will post PR when tests pass locally.

emma_release: will update release notes & schedule a canary window once rc.7 is green.

deploy-bot: final update: deploy remains blocked until DEPLOY-1023 resolved. CI re-run attempts: 1 attempted, 1 failed.

zoe_pm: thanks everyone. please keep the thread updated with PR links and the infra ticket. :thumbsup:
